newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iranian Foreign Minister leaves for Syria.
newsitem.headline: Iranian Foreign Minister leaves for Syria.

text.p: Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati left for Damascus on Monday to meet Syrian officials, the state-run Iranian news agency IRNA reported.
It said Velayati would deliver a written message to Syrian President Hafez al-Assad from Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani.
He would also discuss bilateral relations and Middle East developments in meetings with senior officials, the agency added.
Syria is Tehran's closest ally in the Middle East. Damascus has played a mediating role in settling disputes between Iran and its Gulf Arab neighbours.
Syria supported Iran during its 1980-88 war with Iraq.
